title: 2nd Stalking
alt: Charcoal drawing of five standing nude figures, and a photograph documenting the drawing left in a public park.
description: I placed a drawing in a public park and hid nearby for several hours, waiting to observe any interaction with passersby. After a long wait, someone finally stopped to look at the drawing. He took it, tore it apart, and threw it into the garbage. I felt excited watching this unfold, even though the outcome was not what I had anticipated.

title: Quickness
alt: Grid of stop-motion animation frames showing a running paper figure.
description: An ongoing project drawing on Italo Calvino's Six Memos for the Next Millennium. I am currently concluding the chapter on Quickness, exploring how each concept can be articulated through analog stop-motion and examining the workings of the medium itself — photographing each frame by cellphone and assembling the sequence into a GIF.

title: Sketching

description: Quick studies from life-drawing sessions — a regular practice that runs alongside the larger finished paintings.
